title: It Looks Like a Pond. Divers Call It Everest.

lines.text: This pond has killed at least ten divers.
From above, it's just a pond in the woods.
Below, a narrow shaft called the Chimney drops into the dark.
Then it opens into a huge room divers call the Ballroom.
Florida's Eagle's Nest. Divers call it the Mount Everest of cave diving.
The cave runs on past the Ballroom, to about 300 feet deep.
120 feet down, there's a sign with the Grim Reaper on it.
It reads: Stop. Prevent your death. Go no farther.
In 1999, partly over safety fears, it was closed to divers.
Cave divers pushed back. It reopened in 2003.
October 2016. Three friends came to dive it.
One stayed near the surface. Two experienced divers went deep.
They were due back within an hour. They never surfaced.
Recovery divers found them the next morning, around 260 feet down.
Exactly what went wrong is still unclear.
And from above, it still looks like a pond.

shots.description: COLD OPEN, camera already moving. Top-down drone view of a small, still, dark-green pond ringed by swamp woods and a sandy dive-entry slope. Morning light. Nothing about it looks dangerous.
shots.camera: Top-down 28 mm, slow descending push toward the pond centre (pond fills the middle third).
shots.lighting: Soft morning sun, light haze; pond surface reflects sky.

shots.description: Ground level at the water's edge: cypress knees, duckweed-green surface, a dragonfly-sized speck skims. A dive line tied to a root disappears into the water (the only hint).
shots.camera: Low 35 mm dolly along the bank; rack focus from the bank to the line entering the water.

shots.description: Camera sinks through the green surface. Light dies fast. A single diver (blue fins) descends head-down through a narrow rock throat barely wider than his tanks, following the line.
shots.camera: Continuous move from above water to below (water plane wipe), then top-down 20 mm following the diver.
characters: diver_A (blue fins, twin tanks, helmet torch, faceless)
shots.lighting: Green daylight from above fading to black; torch cone.

shots.description: THE REVEAL. The diver drops out of the shaft's mouth into a vast black chamber; his torch beam reaches nothing. A slow pull-back shows him as a speck at the ceiling, with a mound of debris rising from the floor far below.
shots.camera: Wide 18 mm pull-back and tilt down, scale reveal; diver tiny in the upper third.
shots.lighting: Torch cone + one faint shaft of green daylight from the chimney; volumetric.

shots.description: Pattern interrupt. Map card of Florida; route line draws south along the Gulf coast; pin drops north of Tampa near Weeki Wachee.
shots.camera: Overlay card over a blurred Ballroom background.

overlay.text:
EAGLE'S NEST SINK
HERNANDO COUNTY, FLORIDA

shots.description: Schematic side-section: pond at top, thin chimney, the wide Ballroom, then tunnels stepping down and away. A cyan dot travels the route; a depth bar fills.
shots.camera: Locked diagram; slow vertical pan downward with the dot.

shots.description: The diver's torch sweeps the debris slope and lands on a square white sign on a pipe stake, a simple hooded-skeleton silhouette printed on it. Silt drifts across.
shots.camera: POV 24 mm handheld; pan stops dead on the sign; slow push.

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. Close-up of the sign face; lettering readable: STOP! / PREVENT YOUR DEATH! / GO NO FARTHER. Torchlight flickers across it once.
shots.camera: Macro 50 mm, slow push; slight handheld.

shots.description: Pattern interrupt. Timeline card over the dark pond surface: 1981 (first deaths counted), 1999 CLOSED.
shots.camera: Overlay; background slow drift over the pond at dusk.

shots.description: Timeline extends: 2003 REOPENED. Behind it, the pond at dawn with a dive line again tied to the root.
Afternoon at the bank: three faceless figures in wetsuits sort tanks beside the pond; long shadows.
shots.camera: Wide 28 mm from across the pond, slow dolly-in.
characters: figure x3 (silhouettes, wetsuits, no faces, not named)

shots.description: Under the pond: one diver hovers in the green light near the top of the Chimney; below him two torches shrink down the shaft into black.
shots.camera: Top-down 24 mm from above the hovering diver, looking past his fins at the two lights going down.
shots.lighting: Green daylight top, two torch cones below.

shots.description: The pond surface from the bank, perfectly still; a trail of bubbles slows and stops. The timer turns red past 60 minutes. Light fades toward evening.
shots.camera: Locked-off 35 mm, low over the water; light timelapse.

shots.description: Section again: the cyan route line runs to a deep tunnel; two small dim grey dots sit close together at a marker. No bodies, no detail.
shots.camera: Locked; slow push toward the marker.
shots.lighting: Graphic; the dots glow faintly then dim.

shots.description: A deep, empty tunnel: a guideline running into black, silt hanging in a single torch beam that sweeps and finds nothing.
shots.camera: Slow push 35 mm down the line.

shots.description: Camera rises out of the water back to the top-down drone view of the calm green pond — same framing as S01 so the loop into 'This pond has killed at least ten divers' is seamless. Small memorial text fades in and out.
shots.camera: Crane up through the surface to top-down 28 mm; final 0.5 s = S01 first-frame composition.

overlay.text:
IN MEMORY OF EVERY DIVER
LOST AT EAGLE'S NEST

loop_line: And from above, it still looks like a pond.
